bugs.summary: Mean and std are computed on the whole dataset, and train.py calls build_features before the train/test split, so test-set statistics leak into training.
bugs.trigger: Test rows' values shift the mean/std used to scale the training rows; the reported test AUC is optimistic.

related_valid: The scaling statistics are not saved, so inference cannot apply the same transform (train/serve skew).
A zero-variance column (or a single-row input) makes std 0 or NaN, producing NaN/inf features.
